We’ve got your back, Cheryle. Healthcare costs are going down in Ohio after we win & I’ll start by prosecuting the fraudsters who are raising prices for everyone else.

Video

Lowering healthcare costs is a top priority for me & the lowest-hanging fruit is crystal clear: crush Medicaid fraud. I’ll strike a deal with the federal government that allows Ohio to keep billions in savings & bring down healthcare costs for law-abiding citizens across our state.

Unfortunately there’s one campaign promise I CAN’T make…said with full love to my hometown friends in Cincinnati.

Video

This is from UC Berkeley’s own faculty, but I couldn’t have said it better myself: “Admitting severely underprepared students to advanced programs at the wrong schools serves no one but administrators who build careers by promoting ideological goals.”


Wall Street Journal Opinion (@WSJopinion)

The University of California needs the SAT back. Even the overwhelmingly liberal Berkeley faculty are fed up with the admission of unprepared students, write Svetlana Jitomirskaya and Zvezdelina Stankova

The most reasonable objection to my plan to combat Medicaid fraud in Ohio is that it isn’t big enough to move the needle on lowering healthcare costs overall. Here’s why that view is wrong: we’re going to deliver billions in direct savings & lower pricing pressure at the same time.

Video

Combating Medicaid fraud & return billions in savings to law-abiding Ohioans is practical, impactful, and rapidly achievable - in contrast to the socialist takeover of healthcare that my leftist opponent is trying to push onto Ohioans.

Video

Looking forward to getting started on the real mission in January: improving the lives of the nearly 12 million people who live in our state.

Video

Congrats to the St. X tennis team on an incredible state championship. From a proud alum - let’s go Bombers!


Cincy St. X Sports (@stxsports)

Now Introducing… 2026 OTCA Division 1 TEAM State Champions

St. Xavier Bombers Tennis!

#GoBombers | #AMDG

Great night at the Breakaway Music Festival in Columbus. Met a lot of young people looking to move back to Ohio, where they grew up, instead of staying in the more expensive and less convenient big cities they moved to as young adults. A ton of fun and great energy right here in the center of OH.

It’s time to celebrate the ideals of 1776 in the year 2026. 🇺🇸 🇺🇸

Video

Courage doesn’t simply mean you have deep convictions. It means you are willing to make a sacrifice to advance those convictions, even at considerable personal loss.

Video

There are two Ohios we could wake up to on Nov 4. It can be an Ohio where we celebrate success, faith, family, patriotism, and hard work. Or it can be an Ohio led by a socialist who rejects the values that made us great. That’s up to us to choose.

Video

Congrats Shrey! 💪🏼


Columbus Dispatch (@DispatchAlerts)
